communityGuidelines.title: Community Guidelines
communityGuidelines.intro: Our guidelines help keep the platform safe, respectful, and enjoyable for everyone.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Our platform is built to help people create, share, and connect safely. These guidelines define what is allowed and what is not.

sections.title: Content Moderation
sections.body: We review content using automated systems and manual checks. Violations may result in:

sections.title: Respectful Behaviour
sections.body: Treat others with respect. Avoid targeting individuals or groups.

items.question: Why was my content removed?
items.answer: It may have violated one or more guidelines such as harmful, misleading, or inappropriate content.

items.question: Can I appeal a decision?
items.answer: Yes, you can request a review if you believe a mistake was made.

items.question: Do these rules apply to private content?
items.answer: Yes, all content shared on the platform must follow guidelines.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Your safety matters. This section helps you protect your account and manage your experience.

sections.title: Privacy Controls
items: Manage who can see your content

items.question: How do I report a user?
items.answer: You can report directly from their profile or content.

items.question: Will users know if I report them?
items.answer: No, reports are private.

items.question: How do I unblock someone?
items.answer: You can manage blocked users in your privacy settings.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: These terms define how you can use the platform and what is expected from users.

sections.title: Using the Platform
sections.body: You must use the platform responsibly and follow all rules.

sections.title: Prohibited Use
items: Attempting to harm or disrupt the platform

sections.title: Service Changes
sections.body: We may update features, policies, or services at any time.

items.question: Can my account be suspended?
items.answer: Yes, if you violate the terms.

items.question: Can I have multiple accounts?
items.answer: Only if allowed under platform rules.

items.question: Do terms change over time?
items.answer: Yes, terms may be updated periodically.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: We are committed to protecting your personal data and privacy.

sections.title: Data Protection
sections.body: We use security measures to protect your information.

items.question: Is my data shared with others?
items.answer: Only when necessary and according to policy.

items.question: Can I delete my data?
items.answer: Yes, depending on your account settings.

items.question: Is my information safe?
items.answer: We use standard security practices to protect it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Earn and manage rewards through your activity on the platform.

sections.title: Misuse
sections.body: Abuse of the rewards system may result in:

items.question: Why didn't I receive rewards?
items.answer: The activity may not meet eligibility criteria.

items.question: Do rewards expire?
items.answer: Yes, depending on the policy.

items.question: Can rewards be transferred?
items.answer: No, rewards are tied to your account.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: This policy covers the use and ownership of digital content on the platform.

sections.title: Your Content
sections.body: You retain ownership of the content you create.

sections.title: Platform Usage Rights
sections.body: You grant the platform permission to display and distribute your content.

sections.title: Content Removal
sections.body: We may remove content that violates rights or policies.

items.question: Do I own my uploads?
items.answer: Yes, you retain ownership.

items.question: Can others use my content?
items.answer: Only if permitted by you or platform rules.

items.question: What happens if I upload copyrighted content?
items.answer: It may be removed.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body: We provide additional protections for younger users to ensure a safe environment.

sections.title: Privacy for Teens
items: Accounts may be private by default

sections.title: Parental Awareness
sections.body: Encourage safe usage and awareness for younger users.

items.question: Are teen accounts private by default?
items.answer: Yes, for added safety.

items.question: Can teens receive messages from everyone?
items.answer: No, messaging is restricted.

items.question: What protections are included?
items.answer: Privacy controls, content filters, and limited interactions.
